shortDescription: Create Thin Clones on Dell PowerFlex 5.x (Gen2)

options.name: from_snapshot_id
options.description: ID of the source (read-only) snapshot. Mutually exclusive with I(from_snapshot_name), I(from_volume_name), and I(from_volume_id).

options.name: from_snapshot_name
options.description: Name of the source (read-only) snapshot. Mutually exclusive with I(from_snapshot_id), I(from_volume_name), and I(from_volume_id).

options.name: from_volume_id
options.description: ID of the source volume (or source thin clone). Mutually exclusive with I(from_volume_name), I(from_snapshot_name), and I(from_snapshot_id).

options.name: from_volume_name
options.description: Name of the source volume (or source thin clone). Mutually exclusive with I(from_volume_id), I(from_snapshot_name), and I(from_snapshot_id).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: new_clone_name
options.description: Name of the new thin clone volume to create. Required. Must be non-empty.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state. This module supports C(present) only. Delete, rename, resize, and mapping are handled by C(dellemc.powerflex.volume_v2).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
